messages.content: I think I need to stop trying to be everyone's favorite person.
Honestly, that's genuinely exhausting to sustain long-term. What made you realize you were doing it?
I noticed I change how I act depending on who I'm around, more than feels natural.
That's honestly a common adaptive habit, but worth examining - some adjustment is normal, but if the core of you keeps shifting, that's worth addressing.
I want to figure out who I actually am underneath all that.
That's honestly a genuinely good place to start from - notice what stays consistent even when you're not trying to please anyone specific.
